summary: Senior Backend Engineer with 10+ years of software engineering experience building scalable distributed systems and cloud-native applications. Experienced in Java, Python, AWS, microservices, event-driven architecture, and production system design. Strong background in API development, reliability, performance optimization, and technical leadership.

experience.title: Senior Backend Engineer
bullets: Designed and built production backend services using Java, Spring Boot, and AWS for high-volume business workflows.
Developed event-driven services using Kafka and SQS with idempotent processing, retry handling, and failure recovery.
Designed REST APIs and PostgreSQL data models supporting scalable customer-facing applications.
Improved production observability through distributed tracing, metrics, structured logging, and automated alerting.
Led technical design reviews and worked with product and platform teams on architecture, delivery, and rollout decisions.

experience.title: Lead Software Engineer
bullets: Led development of distributed backend services supporting real-time operational workflows.
Built scalable APIs and asynchronous processing pipelines using Java, Python, PostgreSQL, and AWS.
Improved reliability through automated testing, monitoring, retry strategies, and production incident remediation.
Mentored engineers and contributed to architecture, code reviews, and engineering standards.

education.degree: Bachelor of Science in Computer Science
